scope: Six isolated Zafran runs; no additional research purchased for this inventory

definitions.research_wall_seconds: Earliest research job start through latest actual research job finish; overlapping person jobs are not added. Includes dossier/import/narrative/finalization.
definitions.wall_seconds: Same start through last finished reconciliation where present; otherwise latest research finish. Blocked, never-started person jobs do not have invented end times.
definitions.pre_formation_seconds: Observable first formation-model-request boundary, not exclusive provider research time.
definitions.costs: Researcher model ledger plus only result-phase provider rows plus one preflight. No estimate/result double count. AI Ark credits stay separate. Failed unpriced calls and external availability probe remain unknown.
definitions.null_link: Artifact not produced or absent; not a broken link.
definitions.authored_vs_imported: Grok47 authored draft has 30 findings but zero imported; typed enrichment claims excluded from authored counts.
definitions.job_costs: Job provider_recorded_usd includes all ledger rows attributed to that job (including common reconciliation on account). research_stage_model_plus_provider_usd excludes that separate reconciliation. Preflight is run-level only. Do not add attributed reconciliation twice.

failures.subject_stage: DeepSeek Nick parent-context read; Muse account completion and both person references
failures.root_cause_classification: Backend reference overwrite
failures.confidence: Confirmed persisted self-parent IDs and code path; downstream impact demonstrated
failures.explanation: `lookup_bound_person` replaced the stored input-reference object using the person job as `parent_job_id`. Nick's DeepSeek job subsequently could not read the completed account dossier; brief/generation references were lost. Both Muse person jobs point to themselves; account finalizer's child-parent query consequently rejects the correct Nick/Vari job IDs. Do not blame Muse for inventing those IDs.

failures.subject_stage: DeepSeek account and Vari early stops
failures.root_cause_classification: Provider/parser/runtime boundary unresolved
failures.confidence: Stop metadata confirmed; exact responsible component unproven
failures.explanation: Last metadata says `finish_reason=tool_calls` with empty public content, then no accepted finalizer. Token counts 9,945 and 3,618 do not establish truncation. Serialized snapshots omit typed tool calls in successful cases too, so missing serialized calls alone cannot diagnose a lost provider tool call. Account 64 findings imported; Vari stopped before deep research/dossier.

failures.root_cause_classification: Provider response error plus observability/status mismatch
failures.confidence: Confirmed metadata; deeper provider cause unproven
failures.explanation: Final response has `finish_reason=error`, 571 output tokens and empty public content, but model ledger labels the call completed. Job ends missing_finalize. The earlier parent-reference bug is a separate failure. Nick's 37 findings imported; no narrative.

failures.root_cause_classification: Shared reconciliation model/schema contract
failures.confidence: Confirmed validator rejection
failures.explanation: First returned an object where `gaps[0]` required a string. Second returned missing/extra keys and malformed contact UUID containing prose. No account narrative was saved. These costs/failures belong to common Muse reconciliation, not DeepSeek research.
